subject: POC sprint kickoff — reschedule, room booking & recording permissions
messages:
From: Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@finexco.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Sasha Lee <sasha@finexco.com>
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — initial scheduling

Hi Priya,

Thanks for the invite. We may need to shift the kickoff from Tuesday 27th to later in the week — several stakeholders have conflicts with an exec review that popped up.

Quick questions to help us decide:
- Can the session be run fully remote if needed, and what changes to the agenda would that imply (particularly for the hands-on routing/load test)?
- If onsite, what are the visitor access rules and how early do we need to submit names for badges?
- Are you able to record the session (we'd like to share a condensed recording internally) and what consent do you require?

We want the hands-on portion to include a prompt review pass and a routing smoke test (target: 20 concurrent users for 10 minutes) — will that be feasible on a single dedicated GPU pool?

Appreciate any options — Sasha and I are flexible on afternoons Thu/Fri PT.

Best,
Alex
Director of Eng, FinexCo
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@finexco.com>
Cc: Sasha Lee <sasha@finexco.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC sprint kickoff — reschedule, room booking & recording permissions

Hi Alex / Sasha — thanks for the heads up. We can definitely support both fully-remote and hybrid formats; the agenda changes are minor but important:

- Remote: we'll run the hands-on prompts via shared Jupyter workspace + a short live walkthrough. For the routing/load smoke test we'll throttle to a simulated 20 concurrent users using our load harness (we'll coordinate exact payloads).
- Onsite: we'll bring the same harness but will request campus network access for load generation and a dedicated AV setup (screen share + recording).

Proposed reschedule slots (PT):
- Thu Apr 29, 1300–1700 PT (preferred)
- Fri Apr 30, 1400–1800 PT

Can you confirm which slot works? If you pick onsite, please send final attendee list (full names + company IDs) by Tue Apr 27 EOD so Karthik can generate badges.

I've attached an updated POC_Agenda_v1.pdf with the hybrid vs remote callouts, and a network_access_form.pdf for any onsite firewall exceptions. Also attaching a Participant_Waiver.docx — security requires signed waivers for visitors doing hands-on work in the lab.

CC'ing Karthik for room/AV booking and Monica for visitor approvals. If everyone agrees on Thu we'll do a short prep call Wed afternoon for the prompt corpus and load payloads.

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
--
Attachments: POC_Agenda_v1.pdf (application/pdf, 128KB); network_access_form.pdf (application/pdf, 45KB); Participant_Waiver.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document, 24KB)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@finexco.com>, Sasha Lee <sasha@finexco.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 08:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC sprint kickoff — reschedule, room booking & recording permissions

Hi all — I can take care of the room reservation and AV. A few details I need from FinexCo to get everything greenlit:

1) Final headcount for onsite (including observers).
2) AV needs: projector + HDMI, room mic for recording, and a wired ethernet drop for the load generator.
3) Desired recording policy: where should the recording live? (Redwood Drive or FinexCo private link)
4) Any special dietary/access requests for visitors.

If Thu Apr 29 is the chosen slot, I'll reserve Conf Room B (capacity 20) and book the AV vendor. If we need a larger footprint we'll move to Conf Room A but that requires extra lead time.

Monica — when you have a moment can you confirm the badge turnaround time if I submit names by Tue 27 EOD? Security asked whether signed waivers are acceptable as a PDF upload to the portal or whether originals are required.

-Karthik
Sr. Facilities Program Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@finexco.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 10:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC sprint kickoff — reschedule, room booking & recording permissions

Karthik / Priya / Alex — we can do badges with 24 hours lead time; PDF-signed waivers are acceptable if they include a scanned signature and company email. Please upload waivers to our Visitor Portal (link below).

Visitor Portal: https://redwoodcorp.atlassian.net/servicedesk/visitor-portal

Recording policy: Redwood will store the recording in a restricted Drive folder and share a time-limited view link with FinexCo. If FinexCo prefers to host internally, we can stop recording at any time and provide the raw file after the session.

Monica Patel
Security & Workplace Operations | Redwood Inference
From: Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@finexco.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Sasha Lee <sasha@finexco.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2027 15:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC sprint kickoff — reschedule, room booking & recording permissions

Thanks everyone — Thu Apr 29, 1300–1700 PT works for us and we'll be onsite.

Headcount: 7 (3 engineers, 2 product managers, 2 exec observers).
AV: projector + HDMI, room mic + recording. We are fine with Redwood storing the recording; please provide the restricted Drive link after the session.

Waivers: we'll upload signed PDFs to the Visitor Portal by Tue EOD (I'll have Sasha own this).

Load test: we'll run the 20 concurrent user smoke test described earlier. Priya, can we lock a short prep call for Wed Apr 28 1530 PT to finalize the prompt set and load payloads?

Alex
Director of Eng, FinexCo
